prompts.name: 05-gameplay
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished full-screen portrait 9:16 mobile WeChat casual deduction game UI design, no phone bezel, no presentation board. Game 数字炸弹. Cohesive art direction: warm walnut tabletop, deep teal felt, cream cards, restrained coral-orange primary buttons, amber lighting, tactile illustrated 2.5D game art made feasible with layered 2D sprites. Beautiful readable Simplified Chinese typography, large digits, clear touch targets, generous safe top and bottom areas. Friendly intimate tabletop duel, not casino/gambling; no chips, money, ads, currency, promotional badges or AI badges. All profile names and avatar illustrations are fictional. SCREEN: active gameplay, first-person sitting at near edge of table, opponent sits at far/top edge. Top opponent small illustrated bust, nickname 林间晚风 and four overlapping card BACKS only. Perspective tabletop recedes upward. Header 第3轮 / 20. Center little charming mechanical numeric bomb verifier with amber display 命中 2/4 and small text 上次猜测 0453. A clear four-slot editable slip labeled 本次猜测 shows 0 1 8 3. At near edge above keypad the player's hand holds four cream cards labeled 我的底牌 · 已锁定, digits 1 1 2 2 facing viewer, these are visibly separate from guess slip. Small player portrait and nickname 半杯柠檬. A side notebook tab 记录. Turn label 轮到你了 and timer 24s. Bottom compact numeric keypad rows 1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9 / 删除 0, and wide orange 确认猜测 button. Composition allocates enough room for all controls without overlapping the hand. Show a functional legible premium mobile game screen, make the scene immersive rather than flat form panels. Do not reveal opponent secret digits or highlight any correct digit positions.
